Container.Name: media-issue-agent
Container.Overview: Optional human-in-the-loop media issue triage agent for Plex-native reports and Seerr-family issues. Uses media-mcp for media APIs and local Codex ChatGPT auth; generic API-key auth for Codex is not accepted. Optional Slack moderation uses a separate restricted key.
Container.Requires: Create the Docker network first: docker network create codex-mgmt. Install media-mcp first. Publish only the password-protected WebUI port, and expose it only on LAN, VPN, or Tailscale.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent state and Codex ChatGPT authentication. The host directory must be writable by container uid/gid 1000 and treated as secret.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the password-protected media issue agent Web UI. Expose only on LAN, VPN, or Tailscale.

Config.Name: Media MCP Bearer Token
Config.Description: Bearer token used to call media-mcp. Use the media-mcp token or a future scoped token.

Config.Name: WebUI Password
Config.Description: Password for the required operator WebUI login.

Config.Name: Pushover App Token
Config.Description: Optional Pushover application API token. When paired with a user key, the agent reports newly open non-Slack issues and redacted Slack message previews.

Config.Name: Pushover User Key
Config.Description: Optional Pushover user or group key for issue and Slack message notifications.

Config.Name: Slack Enabled
Config.Description: Enable the optional Socket Mode Slack bot for one public channel and direct messages.

Config.Name: Slack App Token
Config.Description: Secret Slack app-level Socket Mode token beginning with xapp-. Create it with connections:write.

Config.Name: Slack Bot Token
Config.Description: Secret Slack bot OAuth token beginning with xoxb-.

Config.Name: Slack Channel ID
Config.Description: ID of the one public Slack channel where app mentions and tracked issue-thread replies are accepted.

Config.Name: Slack Moderation API Key
Config.Description: Restricted OpenAI Platform API key used only with the free omni-moderation endpoint. Required when Slack is enabled and never passed to Codex or media-mcp.
